profile_text.body:
InVideo describes itself as a video creation platform where users can create and edit AI videos without needing AI expertise. The company's approach centers on its editing agent, which it calls Agent Two. According to its website, users describe edits in plain language, and the agent executes those changes on a real multitrack timeline that can be taken over and adjusted at any frame.

InVideo offers a product called InVideo, categorized as a video generation and editing tool. The platform is designed for editors rather than AI specialists, positioning itself as a way to streamline the video creation and editing process through natural language instructions.
